title: Office Order No.A.1307/1979 dated 27/08/2026, regarding reallocation work of representing the Department in Departmental Appeal & Suo Motu Review.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read: Office Note dated 25/08/2026 of Law Officers’ Branch and order thereon passed

FULL TEXT:
Read: Office Note dated 25/08/2026 of Law Officers’ Branch and order thereon passed
by the Honourable Chief Justice.
OFFICE ORDER
No. A.1307/1979
The Honourable Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Anmedabad has been
pleased to re-allocate the work of representing the Department in the Departmental
Appeals and Suo Motu Review before the Honourable Administrative Judge, to the
Registrar (Legal, Law & Inquiry), High Court of Gujarat, as per the scope of his
working, with immediate effect.
High Court of Gujarat, at Sola,
Ahmedabad - 380 060. hea
(Hemang R. Rawal)
